subject: Pip the Playful Sea Otter Pup
character_dna: Ultra-thick 6pt smooth outlines with oversized rounded head, chubby bean-shaped body, stubby flippers, tiny rounded ears, simple button nose, two sweet whisker dots per cheek, huge circular eyes, completely free of human clothing or human anatomical features.
habitat_rules: Crystal-clear calm coastal cove, glassy surface water, gentle smooth wave curves, giant wide kelp fronds, and rounded sea boulders; zero intricate background textures or clutter.

scenes.action: Pip floats on his back in calm water, rubbing his sleepy eyes with both chubby flipper paws.
scenes.micro_prompt: Count the 2 warm morning sunbeams shining down!

scenes.action: Pip stretches his little body long and straight, pointing both flippers high into the open sky.
scenes.micro_prompt: Color Pip's round belly with your favorite warm crayon!

scenes.micro_prompt: Count the 2 big splashing water drops!

scenes.micro_prompt: Color the breakfast clam shell bright pastel pink!
